about.heading: About the club
about.title: Built for teams
about.lead: Dark, quiet, clean. OMG Cyber Zone has been open in Baku since 2023.
body: A main hall, a PlayStation hall, a lounge and three private rooms. Every station has a 240 Hz monitor and a DXRacer chair, and in the PRO zone the screens run at 500 Hz.
We built this place around teams. Come as five, take a room, close the door and play until morning — we never close.

rooms.heading: Choose your zone
rooms.midweekNote: The 3, 5, 7 and 9 hour packages are night-only — from 16:00 to 08:00.
rooms.weekendNote: At weekends and on public holidays every package is valid around the clock.

descriptions.standart: Thirty stations in the main hall — the heart of the club. Core i5-12400F, RTX 3060 Ti and a 240 Hz DELL screen at our lowest hourly rate.
descriptions.vip: Ten stations, a real step up in power: Core i7-12700F, RTX 3080 and 32 GB of RAM on the same 240 Hz screens.
descriptions.pro: Five stations built for competitive play: Core i7-12700F, RTX 4070 Ti and a 500 Hz monitor — the fastest screens in the club, with Logitech Superlight 2 and Logitech PRO gear.
descriptions.ps: Six PlayStation 5 seats in a hall of their own — sofas, controllers and room for a full lobby.
descriptions.premium: A private room for a whole team: five PCs on 2K 240 Hz monitors plus a PlayStation 5. Close the door and the room is yours.

items.question: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
items.answer: Unfortunately, bringing your own food and drinks into the club is not allowed. There is no need to worry about it though — we offer a very wide range of drinks and snacks at fair prices.

items.question: Can I connect my own devices (mouse, keyboard, headset)?
items.answer: Yes, of course. You are welcome to connect your own mouse, keyboard and headset — every PC has easily accessible USB ports. If you need a hand plugging in or configuring your gear, just ask an administrator.

items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: We are open around the clock, 24/7 — including weekends and public holidays. Day rates apply from 8:00 to 16:00 and night rates from 16:00 to 8:00. You will find us at Azadlig Avenue 103E, Baku.

items.question: Is there an age restriction?
items.answer: No, there are no age restrictions — guests of any age are welcome. If you are coming with children, our administrator will help you pick a suitable zone and suggest games to match.
